text:
maya: Kicking off a short thread for the release notes + changelog entry that touches Go SDK snippets, a tiny migration how-to, and a docs smoke-check checklist. Aim to keep copy tight for marketing.
oliver: What's the concrete Go change?
maya: Go SDK renamed ServerParam -> RequestField in v0.6; also we changed the package import path from github.com/redwood/inference/sdk to github.com/redwood/sdk/go in examples. Need to update all go snippets.
kevin: i'll take the go generation and examples under docs/sdk/go/generation.md and docs/sdk/go/chat.md. will open PR #3901.
nora: i'll do a grep for the old import path and ServerParam across the repo and open a patch PR for remaining spots. Found 7 occurrences so far.
docs-bot: PR #3901 opened by kevin 07 Go snippet updates (generation/chat).
maya: migration note should be short: show old -> new example plus a one-liner about compatibility. e.g. 
```n// old
import "github.com/redwood/inference/sdk"
param := sdk.ServerParam{Text: "hi"}
// new
import "github.com/redwood/sdk/go"
param := sdk.RequestField{Text: "hi"}
```
kevin: will use that. also standardize comment header to "Examples use Go SDK v0.6".
nora: scrubbed occurrences and replaced hardcoded api keys with os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY") pattern in the PR. docs-bot: PR #3902 opened by nora  scrub and import fixes.
tara: small known issue to call out in relnotes: go HTTP client in examples may time out at default 30s for very large streaming responses. Workaround: set Timeout to 0 (no timeout) or increase it to 120s. Internal ticket #524.
maya: add that under Known issues with explicit workaround text. Marketing wants the top bullets to be 2-3 lines only.
kevin: timeline? I can get PRs ready in 2 hours. Need reviews by EOD to make tomorrow's release.
maya: target merge for migrate-go.md + relnotes by 18:00 PT today. kevin/nora: ping owners for review asap.
docs-bot: PR #3902 merged by nora.
kevin: pushed PR #3901. removed old import path and ServerParam references in examples. Also fixed a broken anchor in docs/sdk/go/reference.md where a header id changed.
maya: great. add a docs smoke-check checklist to relnotes (we'll include it as a small subsection):
- run `make docs-preview` and open staging at https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-go-preview
- verify code fences render (go, python, js)
- confirm anchors in reference pages render in TOC
- run `scripts/find-hardcoded-keys.sh` (should return 0)
- sanity-click the migration link from relnotes to migrate-go.md

nora: i ran the smoke-check locally; found one more anchor mismatch in docs/sdk/go/auth.md. opened PR #3905.
docs-bot: PR #3905 opened by nora 07 go auth anchor fix.
tara: also: telemetry flagged that examples with example IDs should use placeholders: replace any value matching rwd_[0-9]{8} with RWD_EXAMPLE_ID.
kevin: i'll add a small regex script to the repo to surface those before merge.
maya: include in the relnotes: "Docs: placeholders standardized for example IDs and telemetry" as a brief bullet.
kevin: adding the rollback alias curl snippet as requested by ops: 
```n# rollback alias example
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/aliases/switch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"alias":"stable-2026-02"}'
```
nora: small localization note: we need short translation strings for the top bullets (DE/FR/ES). i'll extract them once english text is final.
docs-bot: PR #3901 merged by kevin.
maya: relnotes draft pushed to staging and linked: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-go-preview. please run the smoke-check checklist and post any blockers here. aiming for merge by 18:00 PT. last_message_ts=1766004800
